title_primary: 低工资劳动力市场中的企业工资政策
title_secondary: Company Wage Policy in a Low-Wage Labor Market
authors: Giulia Giupponi and Stephen Machin
official: 官方在线 2026-09-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how firms set wages for their employees when they can legally age-discriminate across workers. We exploit an age-specific minimum wage change in the UK, which raised the minimum applying to workers aged 25 and over, leaving unchanged the minima for younger workers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业在法律允许对员工进行年龄歧视时如何设定工资。我们利用英国一项针对特定年龄的最低工资变动，该变动提高了适用于25岁及以上工人的最低工资标准，而未改变年轻工人的最低工资。

title: An Empirically-Grounded Theory of Voting Based on Prosocial Motives
title_zh: 基于亲社会动机的投票行为实证基础理论
title_primary: 基于亲社会动机的投票行为实证基础理论
title_secondary: An Empirically-Grounded Theory of Voting Based on Prosocial Motives
authors: Laurent Bouton, Stefan Krasa, Francesco Squintani
official: 官方在线 2026-09-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose a model of costly voting in a canonical spatial setting that reconciles key empirical features of electoral turnout. We integrate citizens with prosocial voting motives who realize higher payoffs from voting when (i) they expect more fellow supporters to vote, (ii) such votes collectively matter more for winning probabilities, and (iii) they care more about which candidate wins. We establish existence of Nash equilibria satisfying an additional condition that ensures equilibria correspond to those in a finite setting with many voters. We derive how electoral primitives—e.g., voter ideology, voting costs, elite polarization, expected closeness—affect outcomes such as turnout, turnout rates, and winning margins. We relate the predictions to empirical findings both from existing studies and our original data work. With all three prosocial motive components, our model reconciles the empirical regularities qualitatively and quantitatively; while existing models fail on multiple dimensions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个在经典空间设定下的昂贵投票模型，该模型调和了选举投票率的关键经验特征。我们将具有亲社会投票动机的公民纳入考量，这些公民在以下情况下从投票中获得更高收益：（i）他们预期更多支持者会投票，（ii）这些投票在整体上对获胜概率的影响更大，以及（iii）他们更关心哪位候选人胜出。我们确立了满足附加条件的纳什均衡的存在性，该条件确保均衡对应于具有众多选民的有限设定中的均衡。我们推导出选举基本要素——如选民意识形态、投票成本、精英极化、预期竞争程度——如何影响投票率、投票率比例及获胜差距等结果。我们将预测与现有研究及我们原创数据工作的经验发现相联系。结合所有三个亲社会动机成分，我们的模型在定性和定量上调和了经验规律；而现有模型在多个维度上未能做到这一点。

title: Economic consequences of climate change: Evidence from the Philippines
title_zh: 气候变化的经济后果：来自菲律宾的证据
title_primary: 气候变化的经济后果：来自菲律宾的证据
title_secondary: Economic consequences of climate change: Evidence from the Philippines
authors: Radine Rafols
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper evaluates the economic implications of climate change in the Philippines. Data spanning two decades reveal that warmer temperatures increase out-migration, yet locations exposed to intense heat send fewer migrants to historically connected destinations. This pattern raises the question of how climate change affects the spatial allocation of economic activity when mobility is constrained. I employ a quantitative spatial equilibrium model in which rising temperatures and sea-level rise depress local amenities and productivity. Taking climate projections for 2100, I estimate aggregate welfare and output to fall by 15% and 12% respectively, with more prominent losses for high-skilled workers. Large-scale coastal protection can offset damages by up to 3 percentage points, but removing migration barriers attenuates welfare losses by as much as 13 percentage points.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了气候变化对菲律宾的经济影响。跨越二十年的数据显示，气温升高增加了人口外迁，然而遭受酷热地区向历史上联系紧密的目的地输送的移民却较少。这一现象引发了关于在流动性受限时气候变化如何影响经济活动空间布局的问题。我采用了一个定量空间均衡模型，其中气温上升和海平面上升降低了地方宜居性与生产力。依据2100年的气候预测，我估算总体福利和产出将分别下降15%和12%，且高技能工人遭受的损失更为显著。大规模海岸防护措施可抵消高达3个百分点的损害，而消除迁移障碍则能将福利损失减轻多达13个百分点。

title: Unravelling intra-urban spatiotemporal disparities in housing price dynamics: An infrastructural approach using interpretable machine-learning methods in Shenzhen, China
title_zh: 揭示城市内部房价动态的时空差异：基于可解释机器学习方法的深圳基础设施视角分析
title_primary: 揭示城市内部房价动态的时空差异：基于可解释机器学习方法的深圳基础设施视角分析
title_secondary: Unravelling intra-urban spatiotemporal disparities in housing price dynamics: An infrastructural approach using interpretable machine-learning methods in Shenzhen, China
authors: Lirong Hu, Shiliang Su, Shenjing He
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Housing inequalities have long been a pressing global issue, particularly in the context of rapidly transforming urban housing markets. However, intra-urban spatiotemporal disparities in housing price dynamics remain insufficiently understood. By developing an infrastructural approach operationalized through interpretable machine-learning methods that explicitly incorporate spatiotemporal heterogeneity, this study examines the complex capitalization of key infrastructures into housing prices, drawing on 288,570 second-hand housing transactions and multi-source geographic data from 2010 to 2023 in Shenzhen, one of the largest and most dynamic urban housing markets in China. The results reveal increasingly intensified housing price disparities, which are particularly pronounced within school catchment areas and 15-minute infrastructure-accessible neighborhoods. Compared with physical infrastructures, as well as structural and locational attributes, social infrastructures—especially public schools—are more decisively and consistently associated with housing prices. Their spatiotemporally heterogenous capitalization and increasingly salient threshold effects highlight the agency of social infrastructures in leveraging urban development and (re)shaping social inequalities, thereby advancing the understanding of housing price disparities. Finally, this study provides dynamic, fine-grained evidence to support locally calibrated and stage-sensitive urban planning and housing policies.
abstract_zh: 住房不平等长期以来一直是全球性的紧迫问题，尤其是在城市住房市场快速转型的背景下。然而，城市内部住房价格动态的时空差异仍未得到充分理解。通过构建一种基础设施分析方法，并借助可解释的机器学习方法明确纳入时空异质性，本研究考察了关键基础设施对住房价格的复杂资本化效应，基于2010年至2023年间深圳288,570笔二手房交易及多源地理数据进行分析。深圳是中国规模最大、最具活力的城市住房市场之一。研究结果显示，住房价格差异日益加剧，尤其是在学区范围内和15分钟基础设施可达的邻里区域表现尤为突出。与实体基础设施以及结构和区位属性相比，社会基础设施——尤其是公立学校——与住房价格的关系更为决定性和一致性。其时空异质性的资本化效应及日益显著的阈值效应，凸显了社会基础设施在推动城市发展和（重新）塑造社会不平等中的能动作用，从而深化了对住房价格差异的理解。最后，本研究提供了动态、精细化的证据，以支持因地制宜、分阶段响应的城市规划和住房政策。

title: DP11917 Geographical Origins and Economic Consequences of Language Structures
title_zh: 语言结构的地理起源与经济后果
title_primary: 语言结构的地理起源与经济后果
title_secondary: DP11917 Geographical Origins and Economic Consequences of Language Structures
authors: Oded Galor, Assaf Sarid
official: 官方在线 2017-03-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This research explores the economic causes and consequences of language structures. It advances the hypothesis and establishes empirically that variations in pre-industrial geographical characteristics that were conducive to higher returns to agricultural investment, gender gaps in agricultural productivity, and the emergence of hierarchical societies, are at the root of existing cross-language variations in the structure of the future tense and the presence of grammatical gender and politeness distinctions. Moreover, the research suggests that while language structures have largely reflected past human experience and ancestral cultural traits, they have independently affected human behavior and economic outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了语言结构的经济成因及其后果。它提出并实证确立了以下假说：前工业化时期的地理特征差异，这些特征有利于农业投资回报率提高、农业生产力性别差距扩大以及等级社会的出现，是现存跨语言差异中未来时态结构、语法性别及礼貌区分存在性的根源。此外，研究还表明，尽管语言结构在很大程度上反映了人类过往经历及祖先文化特质，它们却独立地影响了人类行为和经济成果。

title: The Pursuit of Non-Trade Policy Objectives in EU Trade Policy
title_zh: 欧盟贸易政策中对非贸易政策目标的追求
title_primary: 欧盟贸易政策中对非贸易政策目标的追求
title_secondary: The Pursuit of Non-Trade Policy Objectives in EU Trade Policy
authors: Ingo Borchert, Paola Conconi, Mattia Di Ubaldo, Cristina Herghelegiu
official: 官方在线 2020-04-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The European Union (EU) often conditions preferential access to its market on compliance with Non-Trade Policy Objectives (NTPOs), including human rights and labor and environmental standards. In this paper, we first systematically document the coverage of NTPOs across the main tools of EU trade policy: its (association and non-association) trade agreements and Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) programs. We then discuss the extent to which the EU can use these tools as a “carrot-and-stick” mechanism to promote NTPOs in trading partners. We argue that, within trade agreements, the EU has limited scope to extend or restrict tariff preferences to “reward good behavior” or “punish bad behavior” on NTPOs, partly because multilateral rules require members to eliminate tariffs on substantially all trade. By contrast, GSP preferences are granted on a unilateral basis, and can thus more easily be extended or limited, depending on compliance with NTPOs. Our analysis also suggests that the commercial interests of the EU inhibit the full pursuit of NTPOs in its trade agreements and GSP programs.
abstract_zh: 欧盟（EU）经常将其市场优惠准入条件与遵守非贸易政策目标（NTPOs）挂钩，这些目标包括人权、劳工及环境标准。本文首先系统性地记录了欧盟贸易政策主要工具中NTPOs的覆盖范围，包括其（联系及非联系）贸易协定和普遍优惠制（GSP）项目。随后，我们探讨了欧盟利用这些工具作为“胡萝卜加大棒”机制，在贸易伙伴中推广NTPOs的程度。我们认为，在贸易协定框架内，欧盟在扩展或限制关税优惠以“奖励良好行为”或“惩罚不良行为”方面的空间有限，部分原因在于多边规则要求成员国实质上取消所有贸易的关税。相比之下，GSP优惠是基于单方面授予的，因此更容易根据对NTPOs的遵守情况予以扩展或限制。我们的分析还表明，欧盟的商业利益制约了其在贸易协定和GSP项目中全面追求NTPOs的努力。

title: DP15800 Whom to Vaccinate First - Some Important Trade-offs
title_zh: 优先为谁接种疫苗——若干重要的权衡取舍
title_primary: 优先为谁接种疫苗——若干重要的权衡取舍
title_secondary: DP15800 Whom to Vaccinate First - Some Important Trade-offs
authors: Rikard Forslid, Mathias Herzing
official: 官方在线 2021-02-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper models the current pandemic to analyze vaccination strategies in a setting with three age groups that differ with respect to their fatality rates. The model also accounts for heterogeneity in the transmission rates between and within these age groups. We compare the outcomes in terms of the total number of deceased, the total number of infected, the peak infection rate and the economic consequences. We find that fatalities are almost always minimized by first vaccinating the elderly, except when vaccination is slow and the general transmission rate is relatively low. In this case deaths are minimized by first vaccinating the middle-aged as this group is responsible for substantial spreading of the virus to the elderly. With regard to the other outcome variables it is always best to vaccinate the middle-aged group first. A trade-off may therefore emerge between reducing fatalities on the one hand and lowering the number of infected as well as maximizing the economic gains from vaccinations on the other hand.
abstract_zh: 本文构建模型模拟当前疫情，以分析在三个年龄组（其病死率各不相同）情境下的疫苗接种策略。模型同时考虑了这些年龄组内部及之间的传播率异质性。我们比较了总死亡人数、总感染人数、峰值感染率及经济后果等方面的结果。研究发现，几乎在所有情况下，优先为老年人接种疫苗能最小化死亡人数，除非疫苗接种速度缓慢且总体传播率相对较低。在此情形下，优先为中年人接种疫苗能最小化死亡人数，因为该群体是病毒向老年人传播的主要源头。就其他结果变量而言，始终以优先为中年人接种疫苗为最优。因此，在减少死亡人数与降低感染人数及最大化疫苗接种经济效益之间，可能存在权衡取舍。

title: Extremal Local Linear Quantile Regression for Heavy-Tailed Time Series with near Epoch Dependence
title_zh: 重尾时间序列近端依赖下极值局部线性分位数回归
title_primary: 重尾时间序列近端依赖下极值局部线性分位数回归
title_secondary: Extremal Local Linear Quantile Regression for Heavy-Tailed Time Series with near Epoch Dependence
authors: Fengyang He, Huixia Judy Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a data-driven inference procedure for extreme analysis of data with near epoch dependence (NED), a condition less restrictive than traditional dependence structures like α-mixing, making it particularly useful for analyzing heavy-tailed time series data. To capture nonlinear data structures, we propose a new framework that combines local linear quantile regression with extreme value theory. We first study the asymptotic properties of the local-linear intermediate conditional quantile (IQR) estimators under NED by establishing the Bahadur representation. While we show the IQR estimator exhibits the desired asymptotic normality for NED data, it is unstable and inaccurate for estimation at extreme quantile levels. Therefore, we develop an enhanced Hill method to estimate the nonlinear extreme value index (EVI) and, consequently, the extreme conditional quantiles (ECQ) based on the tail properties and extrapolation. We show that the proposed EVI and ECQ estimators have the same asymptotic bias. We further develop a bias correction approach to refine these estimators. We thoroughly study the properties of the proposed EVI and ECQ estimators under NED, and their bias-corrected counterparts. Simulation studies and real data analyses demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed methods.
abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种数据驱动的推断程序，用于分析具有近邻依赖（NED）数据的极端值，这一条件比传统依赖结构如α-混合更为宽松，特别适用于分析重尾时间序列数据。为捕捉非线性数据结构，我们提出了一种结合局部线性分位数回归与极值理论的新框架。我们首先通过建立Bahadur表示，研究了在NED条件下局部线性中间条件分位数（IQR）估计量的渐近性质。虽然我们证明了IQR估计量在NED数据下展现出理想的渐近正态性，但在极端分位数水平下其估计不稳定且不准确。因此，我们开发了一种增强的Hill方法来估计非线性极值指数（EVI），并进而基于尾部性质和 extrapolation 估计极端条件分位数（ECQ）。我们证明了所提出的EVI和ECQ估计量具有相同的渐近偏差。我们进一步开发了一种偏差校正方法来优化这些估计量。我们深入研究了在NED条件下所提出的EVI和ECQ估计量及其偏差校正版本的性质。模拟研究和实际数据分析证明了所提出方法的有效性和适用性。

title: Mandated board independence and shareholder value: Evidence on the role of firm characteristics
title_zh: 强制董事会独立性与股东价值：基于公司特征作用的证据
title_primary: 强制董事会独立性与股东价值：基于公司特征作用的证据
title_secondary: Mandated board independence and shareholder value: Evidence on the role of firm characteristics
authors: Edward Kim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The agency literature generally argues that insider-dominated boards exacerbate agency conflicts and reduce shareholder value. However, other theories suggest that insider control may be efficient for certain firms. Using the staggered implementation of mandatory board independence requirements under the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and related exchange rules, I examine how shifts in board control from insiders to independent directors affect firm value. Among initially insider-dominated firms that remain publicly listed and transition to independent-majority boards, Tobin's Q increases by 7.8% on average. Cross-sectional analyses show that the valuation gains are concentrated among firms where compliance requires substantive changes in board composition and among firms with lower organizational complexity. However, the valuation benefits are significantly weaker when CEOs are highly entrenched. Additional evidence suggests that independent-majority boards may strengthen corporate oversight, as reflected in greater CEO turnover-performance sensitivity. Overall, the findings suggest that the effects of board independence regulations depend systematically on organizational characteristics and internal power structures.
abstract_zh: 代理文献普遍认为，内部人主导的董事会会加剧代理冲突并降低股东价值。然而，其他理论则指出，对某些企业而言，内部人控制可能是有效率的。利用《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》及相关交易所规则下强制董事会独立性要求的逐步实施，我考察了董事会控制权从内部人向独立董事转移如何影响企业价值。在最初由内部人主导、随后保持公开上市并过渡至独立董事占多数的董事会中，托宾Q平均上升了7.8%。横截面分析显示，估值收益集中在那些合规要求实质性改变董事会构成的企业，以及组织复杂性较低的企业中。然而，当首席执行官高度固守其职位时，估值收益显著减弱。额外证据表明，独立董事占多数的董事会可能强化公司监督，这体现在首席执行官更替与业绩敏感性的增强上。总体而言，研究结果表明，董事会独立性监管的效果系统性地依赖于组织特征和内部权力结构。

title: Long-run effects of technological change: the impact of automation on intergenerational mobility
title_zh: 技术变革的长期效应：自动化对代际流动性的影响
title_primary: 技术变革的长期效应：自动化对代际流动性的影响
title_secondary: Long-run effects of technological change: the impact of automation on intergenerational mobility
authors: Fredrik Heyman, Martin Olsson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how automation affects intergenerational income mobility. Using Swedish register data for parents and children from 1985–2019, we study how parental exposure to robots during the 1990s shaped children’s outcomes up to thirty years later. Combining occupational exposure measures with industry- and firm-level robot adoption, we find that automation reduced children’s income and upward mobility and worsened long-run labour market and educational outcomes. These effects are concentrated among low-income families and appear driven primarily by adverse parental labour market shocks and financial strain. Our findings suggest that technological change can reduce intergenerational mobility and increase long-run inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文考察自动化如何影响代际收入流动性。利用1985-2019年瑞典父母与子女的登记数据，我们研究了1990年代父母接触机器人如何影响子女长达三十年后的发展结果。通过将职业暴露指标与行业及企业层面的机器人应用相结合，我们发现自动化降低了子女收入与向上流动性，并恶化了其长期劳动力市场表现与教育成果。这些影响集中于低收入家庭，且主要源于父母劳动力市场负面冲击与财务压力。研究结果表明，技术变革可能削弱代际流动性并加剧长期不平等。

title: Target-driven Bayesian stacking of realized and implied volatility forecasts
title_zh: 目标驱动的已实现波动率与隐含波动率预测的贝叶斯堆叠
title_primary: 目标驱动的已实现波动率与隐含波动率预测的贝叶斯堆叠
title_secondary: Target-driven Bayesian stacking of realized and implied volatility forecasts
authors: Hongfei Guo, J.M. Marín, Helena Veiga
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose target-driven Bayesian stacking for a fixed six-model ensemble of GARCH and stochastic-volatility forecasts with realised- and VIX-based extensions. Two rolling stacking rules target either log predictive density or QLIKE. In S&P 500, the objective changes the preferred information channel: LPD stacking remains centred on GARCH-RV, whereas QLIKE stacking shifts towards GARCH-VIX. Across 56 rolling windows, the QLIKE stack improves certainty-equivalent returns by roughly one to one-and-a-half percentage points per year, depending on the investor’s risk aversion. In the 30 windows where the QLIKE stack assigns material weight to implied volatility models, the gain exceeds two percentage points per year with a 90% win rate. However, LPD stacking delivers tighter 5% Value-at-Risk calibration. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种目标驱动的贝叶斯堆叠方法，用于一个由GARCH和随机波动率预测构成的固定六模型集成，并加入了基于已实现波动率和VIX的扩展。两种滚动堆叠规则分别以对数预测密度或QLIKE为目标。在标普500指数中，目标函数改变了偏好的信息渠道：LPD堆叠仍以GARCH-RV为中心，而QLIKE堆叠则转向GARCH-VIX。在56个滚动窗口中，根据投资者的风险厌恶程度，QLIKE堆叠每年可将确定性等价收益提高约1至1.5个百分点。在QLIKE堆叠赋予隐含波动率模型显著权重的30个窗口中，年化收益提升超过2个百分点，且胜率达90%。然而，LPD堆叠在5%风险价值校准方面表现更优。

title: Long Term Care and Cognitive Impairment in Spain
title_zh: 西班牙长期护理与认知障碍研究
title_primary: 西班牙长期护理与认知障碍研究
title_secondary: Long Term Care and Cognitive Impairment in Spain
authors: Costa-i-Font, Joan, Jimenez-Martin, Sergi, Oliva, Juan, Vilaplana-Prieto, Cristina, Viola, Analía
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The growing prevalence of cognitive impairment (CI) is one of the main drivers of age-related demand for health and long-term care (LTC). In Spain, CI is estimated to affect 18.5% of Spaniards over 65, and 45.3% in those aged 85 and above. This paper draws on a pooled pre-COVID data from a longitudinal sample of individuals aged 65+ to examine the effect of CI and physical limitations on health and long-term care utilisation, estimates its costs, and financial burden. We report four sets of findings. First, we find that socioeconomic status at older age to be the strongest predictor of CI. Second, while both CI and physical limitations increase health and care adult care use, physical impairment is a stronger predictor of overall care utilisation (73% versus 55% for CI alone) and nursing home residence (2.0% versus 0.9%). Third, informal caregiving constitutes the overwhelming majority of dementia costs, accounting for 69–81% of the total. Finally, we estimate that the replacement cost of informal care would exhaust the full budget of Spain’s LTC system (SAAD).
abstract_zh: 认知障碍（CI）患病率的不断上升是年龄相关健康与长期护理（LTC）需求的主要驱动因素之一。在西班牙，据估计65岁以上人群中有18.5%受到认知障碍影响，而85岁及以上人群中这一比例达到45.3%。本文利用新冠疫情前65岁以上个体纵向样本的合并数据，考察认知障碍和身体限制对健康及长期护理使用的影响，估算其成本及经济负担。我们报告四组研究发现。首先，我们发现老年期的社会经济地位是认知障碍最强的预测因子。其次，尽管认知障碍和身体限制均会增加健康及成人护理服务的使用，但身体损伤对总体护理使用（单独认知障碍为55%，身体损伤为73%）和养老院居住（认知障碍为0.9%，身体损伤为2.0%）的预测力更强。第三，非正式照护在痴呆症成本中占据绝对主导地位，占总成本的69%至81%。最后，我们估算，非正式照护的替代成本将耗尽西班牙长期护理体系（SAAD）的全部预算。

title: Resilience is a network property: Europe’s integration test for 2050
title_zh: 韧性是一种网络属性：欧洲2050年一体化考验
title_primary: 韧性是一种网络属性：欧洲2050年一体化考验
title_secondary: Resilience is a network property: Europe’s integration test for 2050
authors: Sebnem Kalemli-Ozcan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Europe is converging on a definition of economic security as reduced dependence – de-risking, reshoring, buying European. This column argues that the definition is mistaken. Three decades of evidence on financial and production networks shows that resilience is a property of a node’s position in the network – the depth, diversity, and quality of its connections – not of the number of connections it has severed for self-sufficiency. Applying this test to critical input supply chains such as energy and defence – with Turkey, the EU’s largest customs union partner, as the defining case – the author argues that Europe passes the initiative’s ‘Singapore test’ only if it treats integration depth, rather than self-sufficiency, as the union’s security variable.
abstract_zh: 欧洲正在就经济安全的定义达成共识，即减少依赖——去风险、回流、购买欧洲产品。本文认为这一定义存在谬误。三十年来关于金融与生产网络的证据表明，韧性取决于节点在网络中的位置属性——其连接的深度、多样性和质量——而非为追求自给自足而切断的连接数量。作者以欧盟最大关税同盟伙伴土耳其作为典型案例，将这一检验标准应用于能源和国防等关键投入供应链，论证指出：只有当欧盟将一体化深度而非自给自足视为联盟的安全变量时，欧洲才能通过该倡议的"新加坡测试"。

title: Professional Motivations in the Public Sector: Evidence from Police Officers
title_zh: 公共部门的职业动机：来自警察的证据
title_primary: 公共部门的职业动机：来自警察的证据
title_secondary: Professional Motivations in the Public Sector: Evidence from Police Officers
authors: Chalfin, Aaron, Goncalves, Felipe
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how public sector workers balance their professional motivations with private economic concerns, focusing on police arrests. Arrests made near the end of an officer's shift typically require overtime work, and officers respond by reducing arrest frequency but increasing arrest quality. Days in which an officer works a second job after their police shift have higher opportunity cost, also reducing late-shift arrests. Combining our estimates in a dynamic model identifies officer preferences over workplace activity and overtime work. Our results indicate that officers' private costs of arrests have a first-order impact on the quantity and quality of enforcement.
abstract_zh: 我们研究公共部门工作人员如何在职业动机与个人经济考量之间取得平衡，重点关注警察逮捕行为。在警官轮班临近结束时进行的逮捕通常需要加班，而警官对此的应对方式是降低逮捕频率但提高逮捕质量。当警官在警察轮班后还需从事第二份工作的日子里，机会成本更高，这同样减少了轮班末段的逮捕数量。通过将我们的估计结果纳入动态模型，可以识别出警官对工作场所活动及加班工作的偏好。研究结果表明，警官的私人逮捕成本对执法的数量与质量具有首要影响。

title: The Long Shadow of School Closures: Impacts on Students’ Educational and Labor Market Outcomes
title_zh: 学校关闭的长期阴影：对学生教育与劳动力市场结果的影响
title_primary: 学校关闭的长期阴影：对学生教育与劳动力市场结果的影响
title_secondary: The Long Shadow of School Closures: Impacts on Students’ Educational and Labor Market Outcomes
authors: Kim, Jeonghyeok
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Each year, about a thousand public schools in the US close, displacing hundreds of thousands of students. I examine the impact of public school closures on displaced students using linked schooling and labor market data from Texas. Using within-school acrosstime/ cohort variation in exposure to school closures, I implement difference-in-differences strategies to identify causal effects. I find that school closures decrease test scores, increase absenteeism, and lead to more disciplinary actions. Furthermore, school closures decrease high school completion, college attainment, employment, and earnings at ages 25–27. These impacts are larger for secondary school students and those from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.
abstract_zh: 美国每年约有上千所公立学校关闭，导致数十万学生被迫转学。本文利用德克萨斯州关联的学校教育与劳动力市场数据，考察公立学校关闭对受影响学生的影响。通过利用同一学校内不同时期/年级群体受学校关闭影响程度的差异，我采用双重差分策略识别因果效应。研究发现：学校关闭导致学生考试成绩下降、缺勤率上升，并引发更多纪律处分。此外，学校关闭还降低了学生在25-27岁期间的高中毕业率、大学入学率、就业率及收入水平。这些影响对中学生及经济弱势背景学生更为显著。

title: Women in the Platform Economy: Descriptive Evidence from Drivers in India and Indonesia
title_zh: 平台经济中的女性：来自印度和印尼司机的描述性证据
title_primary: 平台经济中的女性：来自印度和印尼司机的描述性证据
title_secondary: Women in the Platform Economy: Descriptive Evidence from Drivers in India and Indonesia
authors: Achyuta Adhvaryu, Levina Adiputri, Valentina Brailovskaya, Priyanka Dua, Jenny Susan John 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide descriptive evidence on women's experiences in platform-based driving and delivery work using survey and administrative data from India and Indonesia. Partnering with major two-wheeler platforms, we study representative samples of drivers, oversampling women to examine gender differences (India: 404 women, 2,153 men; Indonesia: 892 women, 2,114 men). Female participation is extremely low -- 0.8% in India and 1.5% in Indonesia -- consistent with barriers related to safety concerns, cultural norms, and limited access to required assets. Among women who do enter, platform work is used differently than by men: women work fewer hours, are more likely to log in during free time, and place greater value on flexibility and supplemental earnings. Women earn less per hour than men -- by 6-8% in India and 8-22% in Indonesia -- differences that align with gendered choices over working times, locations, and service types, likely shaped by safety and domestic constraints. Women also face distinct challenges: higher reported harassment in both countries and, in Indonesia, widespread customer discrimination and higher accident rates. At the same time, a disproportionate share of women were unemployed before joining the platform, and women are more likely than men to report higher current earnings relative to prior work. Together, the evidence highlights how flexibility coexists with persistent gender-specific risks, constraints, and unequal returns in location-based platform work in low- and middle-income country contexts.
abstract_zh: 我们利用印度和印度尼西亚的调查与行政数据，提供了关于女性在平台化驾驶和配送工作中经历的描述性证据。通过与主要两轮车平台合作，我们研究了具有代表性的司机样本，并超额抽样女性以考察性别差异（印度：404名女性，2,153名男性；印度尼西亚：892名女性，2,114名男性）。女性参与率极低——印度为0.8%，印度尼西亚为1.5%——这与安全顾虑、文化规范以及所需资产获取受限等障碍一致。在已进入该行业的女性中，她们对平台工作的使用方式与男性不同：女性工作时间更短，更倾向于在空闲时间登录，并更重视灵活性和补充性收入。女性每小时收入低于男性——印度低6-8%，印度尼西亚低8-22%——这些差异与性别化的工作时间、地点和服务类型选择相一致，这些选择很可能受到安全和家庭约束的影响。女性还面临独特的挑战：两国均报告了更高的骚扰发生率，而在印度尼西亚，还存在普遍的客户歧视和更高的事故率。与此同时，加入平台前失业的女性比例过高，且与男性相比，女性更倾向于报告当前收入高于先前工作。综合来看，这些证据凸显了在中低收入国家的基于位置的平台工作中，灵活性如何与持续存在的性别特定风险、约束及不平等回报并存。

title: Fueling the mind: How local gasoline prices shape household consumption
title_zh: 燃油心智：地方汽油价格如何影响家庭消费
title_primary: 燃油心智：地方汽油价格如何影响家庭消费
title_secondary: Fueling the mind: How local gasoline prices shape household consumption
authors: Di Bu, Yin Liao, Mingcheng Zhang
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how localized gasoline price shocks affect household consumption by linking high-frequency bank transaction data with station-level fuel prices. A 1% increase in local gasoline prices reduces monthly household spending by approximately 0.13%, even after controlling for national fuel price movements. We identify two mechanisms. First, spending declines are larger among fuel-dependent, low-liquidity households, consistent with a budget-constraint channel. Second, highly visible local price spikes reduce spending even among non-car households, consistent with a price-salience channel. We further show that localized gasoline price shocks amplify consumption inequality: low-income households with high fuel exposure experience the largest reductions, particularly in discretionary spending. Our findings show that localized energy price fluctuations shape household consumption through both financial constraints and behavioral responses to salient price signals.
abstract_zh: 我们通过将高频银行交易数据与加油站级别的燃油价格相关联，研究局部汽油价格冲击如何影响家庭消费。即使控制了全国燃油价格变动，当地汽油价格每上涨1%，每月家庭支出约减少0.13%。我们识别出两种机制。首先，在依赖燃油且流动性低的家庭中，支出下降幅度更大，这与预算约束渠道一致。其次，高度可见的局部价格飙升甚至减少了无车家庭的支出，这与价格显著性渠道相符。我们进一步表明，局部汽油价格冲击加剧了消费不平等：燃油暴露度高的低收入家庭经历最大幅度的支出削减，尤其是在可自由支配支出方面。我们的研究结果显示，局部能源价格波动通过财务约束和对显著价格信号的行为反应，共同塑造家庭消费。

title: Unpacking the link between digital investment and supply chain resilience: a dual-chain coupling perspective in TCM enterprises
title_zh: 数字投资与供应链韧性的关系解析：中医药企业的双链耦合视角
title_primary: 数字投资与供应链韧性的关系解析：中医药企业的双链耦合视角
title_secondary: Unpacking the link between digital investment and supply chain resilience: a dual-chain coupling perspective in TCM enterprises
authors: Zhiguang Li, Yushan Chen, Yu Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Under policy incentives, the digital transformation of the traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) industry has emerged as a critical pathway for overcoming structural upgrading bottlenecks and fostering end-to-end collaborative development. Drawing on panel data from 75 listed TCM manufacturing firms in China from 2015 to 2023, this study examines the impact of digital investment on supply chain resilience in TCM leading firms and explores the mediating role of dual-chain coupling between the capital chain and talent chain. Fixed-effects models, Sobel-Goodman mediation tests, and instrumental variable (2SLS) estimation are employed to test the proposed relationships. The results reveal that digital investment significantly enhances supply chain resilience, and that dual-chain coupling serves as the core transmission mechanism, accounting for over 90% of the total effect. These results offer theoretical insights and practical guidance for TCM enterprises seeking to optimize digital strategies, strengthen supply chain resilience, and achieve sustainable and innovation-driven growth.
abstract_zh: 在政策激励下，中医药行业数字化转型已成为突破结构性升级瓶颈、推动全链条协同发展的关键路径。本研究基于2015-2023年中国75家上市中医药制造企业面板数据，考察数字投资对中医药龙头企业供应链韧性的影响，并探究资金链与人才链双链耦合的中介作用。采用固定效应模型、Sobel-Goodman中介效应检验及工具变量两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）对假设关系进行验证。结果表明：数字投资显著提升供应链韧性，且双链耦合构成核心传导机制，其解释力占总效应的90%以上。该研究为中医药企业优化数字战略、强化供应链韧性及实现可持续创新增长提供了理论启示与实践指导。

title: Turbocharging Profits? Contract Gaming and Revenue Allocation in Healthcare
title_zh: 涡轮增压利润？医疗保健中的合同博弈与收入分配
title_primary: 涡轮增压利润？医疗保健中的合同博弈与收入分配
title_secondary: Turbocharging Profits? Contract Gaming and Revenue Allocation in Healthcare
authors: Atul Gupta, Ambar La Forgia, Adam Sacarny
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Firms often exploit weaknesses in government contracts to boost revenues, yet little is known about how they allocate these funds. We study how hospitals allocated $3 billion obtained from gaming a Medicare loophole. The average gaming hospital increased Medicare and total revenue by around 10 percent, implying large spillovers on other payers. Nonprofit hospitals deployed most funds toward operating costs. For-profits—driven by a large chain—deducted funds off their balance sheets, distributing them to executives and shareholders. Accordingly, we detect reductions in mortality only at nonprofits. Our results imply that the consequences of engineered windfalls vary substantially by hospital ownership. (JEL D86, H51, I11, I12, I18, L31)
abstract_zh: 企业常利用政府合同漏洞增加收入，但关于这些资金如何分配的研究甚少。本文研究了医院如何分配通过利用医疗保险制度漏洞获得的30亿美元。平均而言，利用漏洞的医院将医疗保险收入和总收入提高了约10%，这意味着对其他支付方产生了巨大的溢出效应。非营利性医院将大部分资金用于运营成本。营利性医院——由大型连锁医院驱动——则将资金从资产负债表中扣除，分配给高管和股东。相应地，我们仅在非营利性医院中观察到死亡率下降。研究结果表明，意外收益的后果因医院所有权性质而显著不同。（JEL D86, H51, I11, I12, I18, L31）

title: Suburbanisation's impact on local government: New spatial management roles and challenges in the suburbs today
title_zh: 郊区化对地方政府的影响：当代郊区空间管理的新角色与挑战
title_primary: 郊区化对地方政府的影响：当代郊区空间管理的新角色与挑战
title_secondary: Suburbanisation's impact on local government: New spatial management roles and challenges in the suburbs today
authors: Julia Gorzelany, Katarzyna Cegielska, Barbara Olczak, Renata Różycka-Czas
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Suburbanisation is the central force in urban development today. It is particularly impactful in post-socialist countries where its significant momentum and chaotic effects pose challenges to local governance. Although suburbanisation is a well-established field of research, the novelty of this study lies not in reiterating suburban growth itself, but in examining its impact on local governance in suburban municipalities of a post-socialist metropolitan region. The article aims to scrutinise the dynamics of suburbanisation in municipalities adjacent to Kraków and evaluate its effect on governance in the economic, environmental, and societal contexts. The study combines statistical and spatial analyses with surveys conducted among local residents and local authorities, confronting social perceptions with institutional assessments. The results indicate highly dynamic suburbanisation, land cover transformation, pressure towards new infrastructure, and social conflicts, which hinder municipal governance. They also show that the duration of residence significantly differentiates perceptions of suburbanisation-related problems and expectations towards local authorities. By providing evidence from a post-socialist institutional context, the study contributes to international comparative discussions on the diversity of suburbanisation and local governance models. The conclusions emphasise the necessity of implementing integrated and flexible management, reinforcing planning and participatory instruments that support sustainable development, and improving the quality of life.
abstract_zh: 郊区化是当今城市发展的核心动力，尤其在後社会主义国家中影响显著，其强劲势头与混乱效应给地方治理带来挑战。尽管郊区化已是成熟的研究领域，本研究的创新之处并非重述郊区增长本身，而是探讨其对后社会主义大都市区域郊区市镇地方治理的影响。本文旨在审视克拉科夫周边市镇的郊区化动态，并从经济、环境和社会层面评估其对治理的影响。研究结合统计与空间分析，以及对当地居民和地方当局开展的调查，将社会认知与制度评估相对照。结果表明，高度动态的郊区化、土地覆盖变化、新基础设施压力及社会冲突，阻碍了市镇治理。同时，居住时长显著影响居民对郊区化相关问题的认知及对地方政府的期望。通过提供后社会主义制度背景下的实证证据，本研究为郊区化与地方治理模式多样性的国际比较讨论作出贡献。结论强调，必须实施综合灵活的管理，强化支持可持续发展的规划与参与工具，并提升生活质量。

title: The Search Costs of Inflation in the Labor Market
title_zh: 劳动力市场中通胀的搜寻成本
title_primary: 劳动力市场中通胀的搜寻成本
title_secondary: The Search Costs of Inflation in the Labor Market
authors: Laura Pilossoph, Jane M. Ryngaert, Jesse J. Wedewer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the effect of unanticipated inflation in the labor market. When wages are contracted in nominal terms, inflation reduces real wages, leading workers to intensify on-the-job search to obtain wage-adjusting outside offers. Both the search effort and the resulting job mobility are costly, yet that same mobility raises output by moving workers toward more productive matches. To quantify these costs and benefits, we extend the canonical job ladder of Postel-Vinay and Robin (2002) to a nominal environment with privately chosen search effort, and calibrate it to standard moments from the pre-pandemic US labor market. A one-time inflation shock scaled to the COVID episode generates an average welfare loss of 0.44% of consumption, with workers at the top of the wage distribution bearing losses over six times those at the bottom. Once the offsetting transfer of surplus to firms and productivity gains from reallocation are accounted for, the net aggregate cost is close to zero. Second, inflation volatility imposes asymmetric costs: worker welfare is approximately invariant to the volatility regime because firms compensate workers for expected search costs at hiring, but social welfare declines meaningfully because the resource cost of search effort is not undone by compensation. This second finding identifies a distinct, labor-market source of welfare costs from inflation volatility, complementing the price-dispersion costs emphasized in the New Keynesian literature.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了劳动力市场中未预期通胀的影响。当工资以名义条款签订合同时，通胀会降低实际工资，促使劳动者加强在职搜寻以获得能够调整工资的外部工作机会。搜寻努力及其引发的岗位流动均存在成本，但岗位流动通过将劳动者配置到更具生产力的匹配岗位中提升了产出。为量化这些成本与收益，我们将Postel-Vinay和Robin（2002）的经典工作阶梯模型扩展至包含私人选择搜寻努力的名义环境，并基于疫情前美国劳动力市场的标准矩进行校准。一次与新冠疫情规模相当的一次性通胀冲击会导致平均福利损失相当于消费的0.44%，其中工资分布顶端的劳动者承担的损失是底端劳动者的六倍以上。若考虑企业获得的剩余转移以及岗位再配置带来的生产率提升，净总成本接近于零。其次，通胀波动性会带来非对称成本：劳动者福利几乎不受波动性制度的影响，因为企业在雇佣时会补偿劳动者预期的搜寻成本；但社会福利显著下降，因为搜寻努力的资源成本无法通过补偿抵消。这一发现揭示了通胀波动性在劳动力市场中独特的福利成本来源，补充了新凯恩斯主义文献中强调的价格离散成本。

title: Did the Indian Green Revolution Change the Farm Size–Productivity Relationship?
title_zh: 印度绿色革命是否改变了农场规模与生产率的关系？
title_primary: 印度绿色革命是否改变了农场规模与生产率的关系？
title_secondary: Did the Indian Green Revolution Change the Farm Size–Productivity Relationship?
authors: Rabail Chandio, Leah E. M. Bevis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the relationship between farm size and productivity during India's Green Revolution, a period of rapid technological transformation. Using a unique panel of over 5000 Indian farm households that spans the Green Revolution (1971–1999), we show that the classic (linear) inverse farm size–productivity relationship gradually evolved into the U‐shaped pattern observed today in India, with both small and large farms outperforming mid‐sized ones, by the turn of the century. The roll‐out of high‐yielding varieties seems to have driven this change, and also driven the increased rate of hired labor use and mechanization on large farms (relative to mid‐sized farms) that underpins that enhanced large farm productivity. Last, we show that the Green Revolution may have reduced the propensity of the smallest farms to grow into medium‐sized farms over time.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了印度绿色革命期间，即技术快速转型时期，农场规模与生产率之间的关系。利用跨越绿色革命时期（1971-1999年）的5000多户印度农户的独特面板数据，我们揭示出，经典的（线性）反向农场规模-生产率关系逐渐演变为本世纪初印度所观察到的U型模式，即小型和大型农场的表现均优于中型农场。高产品种的推广似乎是这一变化的驱动力，同时也促进了大型农场（相对于中型农场）雇佣劳动使用率和机械化程度的提高，这支撑了大型农场生产率的提升。最后，我们指出，绿色革命可能降低了最小规模农场随时间增长为中型农场的倾向。

title: Settling prosperity: Historical immigration and its long-term institutional legacies
title_zh: 定居繁荣：历史移民及其长期制度遗产
title_primary: 定居繁荣：历史移民及其长期制度遗产
title_secondary: Settling prosperity: Historical immigration and its long-term institutional legacies
authors: Amanda Guimbeau
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: • Immigrant settlements in the State of São Paulo led to long-term improvements in public goods provision and property rights. • Brazilian municipalities near historical settlements exhibit stronger legal formalization. • In Brazil, historical settlements increased notarial activity and fiscal capacity. • Brazil's state-led immigration policy shaped regional economic and institutional development. During Brazil’s Age of Mass Migration (1880s-1930s), the state sponsored immigrant settlements in São Paulo. Using a new dataset that combines historical and modern administrative records, this paper explores the institutional impact of these settlements. Municipalities closer to them now enjoy better public goods provision and more well-defined property rights, as reflected in structured contractual arrangements, fewer land invasions, and increased investments in high-stakes agricultural practices. Intermediate data show that settlement municipalities recorded higher notarial activity, more frequent legal transactions, and greater land tax revenues in the years following settlement. These changes supported improvements in local governance, legal certainty, and public investment. Overall, the findings highlight how state-led settlement shaped regional economic and institutional development, showing that the implementation of immigration policy had lasting effects on local growth trajectories.
abstract_zh: • 圣保罗州的移民定居点促进了公共物品供给和财产权的长期改善。• 靠近历史定居点的巴西城市表现出更强的法律正规化。• 在巴西，历史定居点增加了公证活动和财政能力。• 巴西国家主导的移民政策塑造了区域经济和制度发展。在巴西大规模移民时期（1880年代至1930年代），国家在圣保罗赞助了移民定居点。利用结合历史与现代行政记录的新数据集，本文探讨了这些定居点的制度影响。靠近这些定居点的城市如今享有更好的公共物品供给和更明确的财产权，这体现在结构化的契约安排、较少的土地侵占以及对高风险农业实践投资的增加上。中间数据显示，定居点所在城市在定居后的几年中记录了更高的公证活动、更频繁的法律交易以及更大的土地税收收入。这些变化促进了地方治理、法律确定性和公共投资的改善。总体而言，研究结果突显了国家主导的定居如何塑造了区域经济和制度发展，表明移民政策的实施对地方增长轨迹产生了持久影响。

title: Adapting to Changing Rainfall and Developing Off‐Farm Employment: Implications for the Adoption of Direct Seeding in Rice Production
title_zh: 适应降雨变化与发展非农就业：对水稻生产采用直播种植的影响
title_primary: 适应降雨变化与发展非农就业：对水稻生产采用直播种植的影响
title_secondary: Adapting to Changing Rainfall and Developing Off‐Farm Employment: Implications for the Adoption of Direct Seeding in Rice Production
authors: Manh Hung Do
official: 官方在线 2026-03-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Rice is the main staple food for more than half of the world's population and the income from rice is an essential source for livelihoods of millions of households. We examine whether direct seed in rice production is an adaptation of rice farmers to rainfall changes and farm labor scarcity. The results show that the deficit changes of rainfall positively associate with the application of direct‐seeded rice. After addressing the simultaneity between direct‐seeded rice application and off‐farm employment, we find a positive correlation of off‐farm employment with direct‐seeded rice application. Thus, stimulating direct‐seeded rice application is recommended for enhancing the adaptation of rice farmers to rainfall changes and for fostering rural transformation.
abstract_zh: 摘要 水稻是全球超过半数人口的主要口粮，其收入也是数百万家庭生计的重要来源。本文考察了水稻生产中的直接播种是否为稻农应对降雨变化和农业劳动力短缺的一种适应策略。结果显示，降雨亏缺变化与直接播种水稻的应用呈正相关。在解决了直接播种水稻应用与离农就业之间的同时性问题后，我们发现离农就业与直接播种水稻应用之间存在正相关关系。因此，建议推广直接播种水稻的应用，以增强稻农对降雨变化的适应能力，并促进农村转型。

title: Seeds of change: The impact of Ethiopia's direct seed marketing approach on smallholders' seed purchases and productivity
title_zh: 变革的种子：埃塞俄比亚直接种子营销方式对小农户种子购买及生产力的影响
title_primary: 变革的种子：埃塞俄比亚直接种子营销方式对小农户种子购买及生产力的影响
title_secondary: Seeds of change: The impact of Ethiopia's direct seed marketing approach on smallholders' seed purchases and productivity
authors: Dawit Mekonnen, Gashaw T. Abate, Seid Yimam, Rui Benfica, David J. Spielman 等
official: 官方在线 2026-02-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract While multiple factors explain low adoption rates of improved varieties by small‐scale farmers in sub‐Saharan Africa, a key supply‐side constraint is the limited availability of seed embodying new traits in the volume, quality, price, and timeliness required by farmers. This constraint is partly attributable to classical failures in the market for seeds and traits. Historically, governments have remedied this failure by allocating public resources to varietal improvement and seed distribution. In 2011, the Government of Ethiopia launched a novel experiment—the direct seed marketing approach—to encourage private seed investment in the country's seed system and to reduce the state's footprint in the system. Direct seed marketing incentivized seed companies to sell directly to farmers rather than through state distribution channels. This study provides the first quantitative assessment of the impact of direct seed marketing based on key indicators of a robust seed system: access to seed and farm‐level productivity. Using a quasi‐experimental difference‐in‐differences approach suitable to handling variation in treatment timing, we find that direct seed marketing increased the share of farmers purchasing fresh maize seed by 15 percentage points. It also raised the quantity of maize seed purchased by 45% and improved maize yields by 18%. In contrast, direct seed marketing had no effect on wheat seed purchases and yields. These crop‐specific differences likely reflect underlying differences in the reproductive biology of maize and wheat, highlighting the importance of crop‐specific policy design, institutional arrangements, and market development strategies to accelerate the adoption of improved varieties.
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管多种因素解释了撒哈拉以南非洲小农户对改良品种采用率低的原因，但一个关键的供给侧制约因素是以农民所需的数量、质量、价格和及时性提供体现新性状的种子供应有限。这一制约部分归因于种子和性状市场中的典型失灵。历史上，政府通过将公共资源分配给品种改良和种子分销来弥补这一失灵。2011年，埃塞俄比亚政府启动了一项新颖的实验——直接种子营销方法——以鼓励私营部门在该国种子体系中的投资，并减少国家在该体系中的足迹。直接种子营销激励种子公司直接向农民销售，而非通过国家分销渠道。本研究基于稳健种子体系的关键指标——种子获取和农场层面生产力——首次对直接种子营销的影响进行了定量评估。采用适合处理处理时间变化的准实验双重差分方法，我们发现直接种子营销使购买新鲜玉米种子的农民比例提高了15个百分点。它还使购买的玉米种子数量增加了45%，并将玉米产量提高了18%。相比之下，直接种子营销对小麦种子购买和产量没有影响。这些作物特异性差异可能反映了玉米和小麦生殖生物学上的根本差异，凸显了作物特异性政策设计、制度安排和市场发展战略在加速改良品种采用方面的重要性。

title: Electoral accountability, distributive conflict, and probabilistic voting
title_zh: 选举问责、分配冲突与概率投票
title_primary: 选举问责、分配冲突与概率投票
title_secondary: Electoral accountability, distributive conflict, and probabilistic voting
authors: David Foster, Joseph Warren
official: 官方在线 2026-02-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Models of electoral accountability typically assume a politician provides a public good. Yet in many contexts, elected officials distribute private goods among voters with conflicting interests. We present a formal model to analyze this situation. An elected official allocates a rivalrous good to a number of voters, who each observe their own allocation but neither others’ allocations nor the official’s action. Each voter’s challenge is to determine whether the incumbent stole from other voters when deciding to sack or retain the incumbent. This problem can be resolved if voters retain the incumbent probabilistically, so that the vote of any voter from whom the incumbent steals is effectively up-weighted. However, this benefit of probabilistic voting also comes with a cost, since the fact that the incumbent may be sacked by mistake diminishes the allocation they are willing to provide to voters.
abstract_zh: 选举问责模型通常假设政治家提供公共产品。然而在许多情境中，民选官员会在利益冲突的选民之间分配私人产品。我们构建了一个正式模型来分析这种情况。一位民选官员将竞争性物品分配给若干选民，每位选民仅能观察到自身所得分配，既无法获知他人分配情况，也无法了解官员的具体行为。当决定是否罢免现任官员时，每位选民面临的挑战在于判断该官员是否侵占了其他选民的应得利益。若选民以概率化方式决定是否留任现任官员，这一问题便可得到解决——因为当官员侵占某位选民利益时，该选民的投票权重实际上会被提升。然而，这种概率化投票机制也伴随着代价：由于官员可能因误判而被罢免，这会降低其愿意向选民提供的分配额度。

title: External marginal costs for road accidents
title_zh: 道路交通事故的外部边际成本
title_primary: 道路交通事故的外部边际成本
title_secondary: External marginal costs for road accidents
authors: Maria Börjesson, Gunnar Isacsson, Viktoria Liss
official: 官方在线 2025-10-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article estimates the external marginal costs of traffic accidents for light and heavy vehicles. We use microdata covering the Swedish national road network from 2004 to 2012. We estimate the risk elasticities for heavy and light vehicles by applying a set of count data models that explain how the number of fatalities, and of severely and slightly injured individuals, changes in response to changes in traffic flows. We analyse the impact of observed and unobserved heterogeneity by applying a range of different model specifications. The weighted average of the external marginal costs for light and heavy vehicles is computed for the full road network, taking into account the degree of risk internalization by vehicle type. The preferred model yields an external marginal cost of 0.28 € cents per vehicle-kilometre (vkm) for light vehicles, and this result is robust across specifications. The estimates for heavy vehicles are more sensitive to the model specification; including or excluding traffic flows of light vehicles has a substantial effect. Our preferred estimate for the external marginal cost of heavy vehicles is 2.36 € cents per vkm. We find negative risk elasticities for both light and heavy vehicles.

title: Energy constraints and firm survival: the case of developing country
title_primary: Energy constraints and firm survival: the case of developing country
authors: Thang Ngoc Doan, Chi Thi Kim Vu, Huong Hoang Diep Truong
official: 官方在线 2025-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates strategies to enhance firms’ resilience to energy resource limitations, drawing on survey data from 2005–2015 from Vietnam’s micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs). We analysed how energy constraints (ECs) affect firm survival, considering internal factors like firm size and export status, alongside external institutional constraints. Using the semi-parametric Cox proportional hazard model and two parametric models (Weibull and exponential), our findings indicate that ECs significantly reduce firm survival prospects through the productivity channel. Propensity score matching-difference in differences further confirmed this relationship, highlighting a stronger impact in environments with limited institutional support. Additionally, our results suggest that internal firm capacities play a vital role in lessening the negative effects of ECs. This research offers meaningful insights for economists and policymakers aiming to develop strategies that strengthen firms’ ability to cope with energy shortages, supporting sustained growth despite energy challenges.

title: The Importance of Well Yield in Groundwater Demand Specifications
title_zh: 井出水量在地下水需求规格中的重要性
title_primary: 井出水量在地下水需求规格中的重要性
title_secondary: The Importance of Well Yield in Groundwater Demand Specifications
authors: Mieno, T., Rouhi Rad, M., Suter, J. F., Hrozencik, R. A.
official: 官方在线 2021-09-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Implementing effective resource management policies critically depends on accurate estimates of the price elasticity of resource demand. In the case of groundwater, previous research estimating well-level groundwater demand has largely neglected the importance of well yield, which is a physical limit on the rate of groundwater extraction. In this study, we empirically estimate the price elasticity of demand for groundwater using well-level data from Colorado. Our results demonstrate that when well yield is omitted, price elasticity is overestimated. This in turn creates inaccurate predictions of the effect of price-based conservation policies on groundwater use and welfare. JEL Q15Q25
abstract_zh: 实施有效的资源管理政策，关键在于对资源需求价格弹性的准确估计。在地下水方面，以往估算井级地下水需求的研究大多忽视了井出水量的重要性，而井出水量是对地下水抽取速率的一个物理限制。本研究利用科罗拉多州的井级数据，实证估算了地下水需求的价格弹性。结果表明，当忽略井出水量时，价格弹性会被高估，进而导致对基于价格的保护政策对地下水使用及福利影响的预测不准确。JEL分类号：Q15，Q25
